Recipients equal the SELECTED GROUP INTERSECTED WITH the poster's own mutual friends (D-C-37). A group member who is not a mutual friend of the poster is NOT a recipient.

requirements.title: Group is a persistent named group chat
requirements.behavior: A Group is a PERSISTENT NAMED GROUP CHAT. Members send text and photos; the group persists between nights; and the current membership is reusable to invite the same people to a Night Out. It supersedes the base PRD exclusion of group chat, and D-C-31 supplies the moderation, blocking, retention and notification-volume policy that exclusion required first. If that administrator leaves or deletes their account, administration transfers to the LONGEST-STANDING REMAINING MEMBER; where membership timestamps tie, the deterministic stable tie-break is the lowest member profile id. If no member remains, the Group is DELETED (D-C-38).

requirements.title: Every operational state names what is true and offers at most one recovery
requirements.entry_point: any surface in a degraded state
requirements.behavior: Each state retains its surrounding context rather than blanking the screen, states plainly what is true, offers at most ONE primary recovery action, and NEVER presents a fallback as a success. Each state declares its focus target, its retry policy, and its async behavior.
requirements.retention: saved data stays visible with a small stale-data label rather than being blanked
requirements.failure_recovery: THE requirement — manual retry, capped at 3 silent auto-retries first; never a vague "error occurred"
requirements.accessibility: focus stays on the recovery action; content is not auto-scrolled
exclusions: no repeat OS permission prompt loop

requirements.title: Recover a degraded Next Bar? surface
requirements.behavior: Finding your five bars keeps the header/skeleton with no auto-scroll and retries automatically after 8s then offers a manual retry. No bars match right now offers Widen distance and re-runs with the wider radius. Location denied offers Choose a neighborhood and re-prompts the OS only if the user opens Settings. You are offline shows the last five bars with their timestamp and a Retry, and never blanks the list.
requirements.retention: the last five bars stay visible with their timestamp while offline
requirements.failure_recovery: exactly one primary action per state
requirements.accessibility: focus stays on the recovery action

requirements.title: Recover a degraded Map surface
requirements.behavior: Location permission denied centres on the last-used neighborhood, shows a muted Locate control, opens the OS Settings deep link once, and never renders the blue dot on a fake centre. No search results keeps the field focused and the typed term and offers Clear search, re-querying on every keystroke. Map failed to load offers Reload map centred on the blank canvas, with filter and search state held in memory and unchanged.
requirements.retention: filter and search state survive a tile failure
requirements.failure_recovery: manual tap only — no silent auto-retry loop
requirements.accessibility: the muted Locate control is visibly disabled

requirements.title: Recover a degraded Rankings surface
requirements.behavior: An empty list keeps the list switcher visible and offers Browse Next Bar? — it is not an error state. A failed score save reverts the row to its prior value until retried, keeps the edit sheet open so nothing is lost, and re-submits the same score on a manual tap.
requirements.trust_boundary: server-owned write
requirements.data_owner: server, on behalf of the account owner
requirements.retention: the edit sheet stays open so nothing is lost
requirements.failure_recovery: manual retry re-submits the same score
requirements.accessibility: the empty state is not styled as an error

requirements.title: Recover a degraded Social surface
requirements.behavior: No friends yet offers Invite friends and the story rail hides rather than showing an empty ring. No plans yet offers Start a Night Out in its unchanged position. A failed invite offers a per-person Resend invite, not a full re-invite; other successful invites are unaffected and already sent.
requirements.failure_recovery: manual per-person resend
requirements.accessibility: the failed invite row is named, not summarised

requirements.title: Recover a degraded Camera or upload
requirements.behavior: Camera permission denied offers Choose from library and a Settings deep link with no repeat prompt loop. Capture failed returns to the shutter and NEVER opens the review screen. Upload queued stays on Compose with a queued indicator and is NOT marked Shared, retrying automatically on reconnect. Upload failed keeps the draft in Compose and never silently drops it.
requirements.trust_boundary: device camera and photo-library permissions
requirements.retention: a failed upload is saved as a draft in Compose and never silently dropped
requirements.failure_recovery: manual retry; auto-retry only on reconnect
requirements.accessibility: a queued upload is labelled queued, never labelled Shared
exclusions: the review-or-retake gate is never bypassed by an upload state

requirements.title: Recover a degraded general surface
requirements.behavior: Showing saved data keeps content visible with a small stale-data label and a Refresh action, and is never blanked; it refreshes in the background on reconnect. Something specific went wrong offers ONE Retry and never says "an error occurred" — after 3 silent auto-retries, the retry becomes manual.
requirements.retention: content stays visible with a stale-data label
requirements.failure_recovery: capped at 3 silent auto-retries, then manual
requirements.accessibility: the message names what specifically went wrong

requirements.behavior: "Sign-in provider unavailable" (Google) and "Verification pending" (SMS code) both depend on providers excluded by D-C-28 and are therefore not built in V8.
